tasks.title: Reuse measured completion review under current material authority
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Measure completion phases before selecting optimization; reusable pure review is keyed by current task/criteria/authority/material/policy/graph/receipt/report interpretation while final current input/contract concurrency fence remains uncached. Explain review reuse separately from native result reuse and actual execution; same-state calls cannot hide stale evidence.
tasks.validation: Existing completion/participant fixtures cover unchanged same-state review, relevant changes to task/report/input/policy/authority, rejection of stale cached verdicts and concurrent mutation detection. Compare representative inclusive timing with limits.
